caption: Luxama v. Ironbound Express, Inc.
citation_line: Luxama v. Ironbound Express, Inc., No. 2:11-cv-02224, ECF No. 460 (D.N.J. Sept. 16, 2024)
headnote_district_ruling: Acting on consent, entered a permanent injunction implementing a 2021 merits ruling that the motor carrier's owner-operator leases violated federal Truth-in-Leasing regulations. The court held that a three-year delay in proposing injunction language did not erase relief already granted.
qualification_rationale: The only selected magistrate decision with identified Third Circuit merits review; it addresses class relief, settlement, excusable neglect, and Rule 65 specificity in an unusual procedural posture.
appellate_posture_note: Affirmed in a nonprecedential opinion, Luxama v. Ironbound Express, Inc., No. 24-2928 (3d Cir. Sept. 12, 2025).
subject_label: Motor Carrier Regulation and Injunctive Relief
